note: Proposals for improving this site. None has been implemented. Each is for a reviewer to accept, reject or change.

suggestions.title: A private calculator that runs in the reader's browser
suggestions.what: Let the owner type the real rent, expiry year, options and tax basis into a form on the Projections page and see the six strategies re-ranked. Nothing would leave the browser and nothing would be saved.
suggestions.benefit: Turns the per-$100 results into the owner's own dollars without putting private figures in a public repository.
suggestions.cost: Medium. The model's rules would be rewritten in JavaScript and tested against the Python model on every build.
suggestions.needs: A decision that client-side entry of private figures is acceptable; a reviewer for the duplicated logic.

suggestions.title: A private build with the real figures
suggestions.what: Keep a second, unpublished copy of the dataset in which the blank property and owner rows are filled, and build the same site from it for the owner only.
suggestions.benefit: Every table would show actual dollars, dates and the after-tax comparison.
suggestions.cost: Low to medium. Needs a private repository or an offline build; the public site would stay as it is.
suggestions.needs: Owner's consent; a place to keep the private copy.

suggestions.title: Scheduled re-verification of every source
suggestions.what: Re-read every source on a schedule and open an issue when the quoted text no longer appears on the page.
suggestions.benefit: Stops the site going stale silently; the Treasury yield, tenant filings and wage rules all change.
suggestions.cost: Medium. The build environment used here cannot reach government sites, so this needs a runner that can.
suggestions.needs: A runner with internet access; agreement on the schedule.

suggestions.title: Neighbourhood-level data around the parcel
suggestions.what: Add census-tract residents, households and income within one and three miles, nearby school enrollment and the parcel's hazard zones.
suggestions.benefit: Replaces city and county averages with the area that actually feeds the restaurant.
suggestions.cost: Low once the address is available, but it can only be published in a private build because it would identify the property.

suggestions.title: Snapshots of each source page
suggestions.what: Store a dated copy or a hash of each page read, so a later reviewer can prove what it said on the access date.
suggestions.benefit: Makes the verification auditable after pages change.
suggestions.cost: Medium. Some publishers restrict copying; storage grows.
suggestions.needs: A decision on which pages may be stored.

suggestions.title: A second, independent check of every verified row
suggestions.what: Have a second reviewer open each source link and confirm the value, recording a pseudonymous initial and date per row.
suggestions.benefit: Four-eyes control on every published value.
suggestions.cost: Medium: a few hours of reviewer time.

suggestions.title: Small charts beside the main tables
suggestions.what: Add simple line charts for residents, school enrollment, the tenant's restaurant count and the range of model outcomes.
suggestions.benefit: Trends are easier to see than to read.
suggestions.cost: Low. The brief asks for tables, so charts would be an addition, not a replacement.

suggestions.title: A printable two-page brief
suggestions.what: A print layout of the executive summary and the decision rule.
suggestions.benefit: Something to hand to an attorney, broker or adviser.

suggestions.title: Exportable checklists
suggestions.what: Download the questions register as a spreadsheet, filtered by who must answer.
suggestions.benefit: Each adviser gets only their own list.

suggestions.title: Move the earlier workbooks under one archive path
suggestions.what: Relocate the 22 earlier workbooks from the top level of the site into an archive folder and leave redirects behind.
suggestions.benefit: A tidier address structure; less chance a reader lands in an old workbook by mistake.
suggestions.cost: Medium, and it touches other sessions' folders and links, which is why it has not been done.
suggestions.needs: Agreement from whoever owns those workbooks; redirect testing.

suggestions.title: Tie tenant failure to regional shocks
suggestions.what: Let a regional disaster raise the chance of tenant failure for a period, instead of treating them as independent.
suggestions.benefit: A more realistic bad case for holding.
suggestions.cost: Low to medium; needs a setting no official source measures.

suggestions.title: An after-tax module
suggestions.what: Compute tax on a sale from basis, depreciation and bracket, including the state and city taxes already verified here.
suggestions.benefit: Replaces the single 'tax drag' setting with the owner's real position.
suggestions.cost: Medium; only meaningful with private inputs.
suggestions.needs: Suggestions SG-01 or SG-02; a tax adviser's review.

suggestions.title: Price the short-lease discount from real quotes
suggestions.what: Replace the assumed extra yield for a short lease with the figures brokers give for this property.
suggestions.benefit: Removes one of the most influential assumptions.

suggestions.title: A decision log
suggestions.what: A page recording each decision taken, the date, the evidence relied on and who agreed.
suggestions.benefit: A clear record for the owner and any successor.
suggestions.needs: Owner's agreement on what may be recorded publicly.

suggestions.title: Key-date reminders
suggestions.what: A table of dates with reminders: lease notice windows, ballot certification, the tenant's next annual report, the July 1 transfer-tax reset.
suggestions.benefit: Guards against a decision by default.
suggestions.cost: Low; lease dates would live only in a private build.

suggestions.title: Protect the main branch
suggestions.what: Require the verification check to pass before a merge, name an owner for the root pages, and allow one integration session at a time.
suggestions.benefit: Parallel sessions twice broke the build by hand-editing generated pages, and many merged in the same hour.

suggestions.title: Decide whether the site should be public
suggestions.what: The repository and the site can be read by anyone. Options: keep as is, ask search engines not to index it, or make the repository private.
suggestions.benefit: The analysis reveals that an owner is weighing a sale, even though nobody is named.
suggestions.cost: Low to change; making the repository private may end free public hosting.

suggestions.title: Remove a personal e-mail address from the repository's history
suggestions.what: Early commits in the repository's history carry a personal e-mail address in their author field (the count is on the Flagged for Review page). Rewriting history would remove it.
suggestions.benefit: Closes the one privacy item this review found. The address does not appear on the site.
suggestions.cost: High and irreversible: every commit identifier changes and every open branch and pull request must be rebuilt.
